title: Empire State Building
summary: The Empire State Building is a 102-story Art Deco skyscraper at 350 Fifth Avenue in Manhattan, designed by Shreve, Lamb & Harmon and built in 1930–31 on the former Waldorf-Astoria hotel site. At 1,250 feet it was the world's tallest building until the 1970s.

uncertainty.note: The Landmarks Preservation Commission gives "Built 1930-31" and completion in April 1931; the building's own site gives 17 March 1930 to 1 May 1931.
